remarks: Light-Filled freshly painted 1-Bedroom End Unit - Walk to Everything!  Welcome to this bright and inviting second-floor (walk-up) 1-bedroom apartment, ideally located in a vibrant and walkable neighborhood. This charming abode features a spacious, well-apportioned living room with oversized windows (Replaced 2018) that flood the space with natural light, a cozy dining area, and a functional galley-style kitchen with tile flooring.  The generously sized bedroom with new AC offers comfort and privacy, while the full bathroom includes a tub/shower combo and a window for natural ventilation.  Additional highlights:  One off-street parking space  Monthly HOA includes cooking gas, hot water, and sewer.  Prime location: Walk to shops, restaurants, and health clubs.  Quick drive to downtown Stamford, Stamford Train Station, and I-95 - perfect for NYC commuters.  Schedule your tour today and see what makes this unit so special!
